listing.name: Robox — robox-recompiled (Eggscantfly)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project describes a native runtime, game features, local setup, mods and saves. Use a Release build for audio pacing; Debug is too slow. A clean source build needs original font assets before building. Portcove has not confirmed broad gameplay, completion or package integrity. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Before configuring source build, supply own unpacked Robox USA.dol plus Assets/fonts/title.brfna and other original Assets. Original data stays user-owned. Runtime importer can accept owned WAD plus Wii common key or manually selected DOL+Assets, but that importer cannot bootstrap its own clean source build without pre-unpacked font assets.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Obtain WiiRecomp source and supply your own unpacked DOL and original Assets before configuring CMake. Build Release on Windows with MSYS2 mingw64, CMake and Ninja, or build.bat. ROBOX_DOL and ROBOX_RECOMPILER can identify your input and compiler. A WAD alone does not establish a working clean-checkout build, and no precompiled package has been confirmed. The recorded review did not run upstream code or assets.
